import csv
from datetime import datetime

baseline_start = datetime(2026, 8, 10)
baseline_end = datetime(2026, 8, 12)
broken_start = datetime(2026, 8, 12)
fix_time = datetime(2026, 8, 21, 12, 0)
after_end = datetime(2026, 8, 24)
loadtest_start = datetime(2026, 8, 18, 10, 0)
loadtest_end = datetime(2026, 8, 18, 12, 0)

baseline = []
broken = []
after = []
excluded = 0

with open('project/data/checkout-latency.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        bucket = datetime.fromisoformat(row['bucket_start'])
        p95 = float(row['p95_ms'])
        
        # Exclude the 4-hour bucket containing the load-test window (08:00-12:00 on 2026-08-18)
        bucket_containing_loadtest = datetime(2026, 8, 18, 8, 0)
        if bucket == bucket_containing_loadtest:
            excluded += 1
            continue
        
        if baseline_start <= bucket < baseline_end:
            baseline.append(p95)
        elif broken_start <= bucket < fix_time:
            broken.append(p95)
        elif fix_time <= bucket < after_end:
            after.append(p95)

baseline_mean = sum(baseline) / len(baseline)
broken_mean = sum(broken) / len(broken)
after_mean = sum(after) / len(after)

print(f"Baseline (2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12): {baseline_mean:.1f} ms")
print(f"Broken window (2026-08-12 to 2026-08-21 12:00): {broken_mean:.1f} ms")
print(f"After fix (2026-08-21 12:00 to 2026-08-24): {after_mean:.1f} ms")
print(f"Excluded {excluded} rows (load-test window 2026-08-18 10:00-12:00)")
EOF
